name: preview-feedback
description: Honor-system feedback for private website previews: pins, threads and resolve, no accounts, no extension.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @preview-feedback/widget build && pnpm --filter @preview-feedback/dashboard build && pnpm --filter @preview-feedback/docs build
scripts.e2e: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @preview-feedback/widget e2e && pnpm --filter @preview-feedback/dashboard e2e && pnpm --filter @preview-feedback/docs e2e
